newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU cuts refund on wheat flour exports - ONIC.
newsitem.headline: EU cuts refund on wheat flour exports - ONIC.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday cut the daily refund on exports of soft wheat flour to 24.00 Ecus per tonne from 26.50 Ecus, France's grain office ONIC said.
The move follows a reduction in the rebate awarded this week for free-market EU soft wheat exports to 17.47 Ecus per tonne from 19.45 Ecus last week.
The flour rebate is usually linked to the soft wheat rebate. To reach a flour rebate the soft wheat rebate is usually multiplied by a coefficient of 1.57.
